name: se
description: Turn ideas into clear Feature plans, deliver them through reviewed pull requests, maintain project knowledge, and audit active work.

interface.shortDescription: Plan Features, deliver reviewed pull requests, and maintain project knowledge.
interface.longDescription: SE supports a complete software-delivery workflow. Learn maintains durable project knowledge and decisions. Idea captures proposals for later planning. Feature turns one or more source issues into a clear Feature Plan Set, with separate Feature issues, practical Macro Tasks, and repository-sensitive dependency intent. Implement delivers each Feature through a dedicated resumable worker, starts stacked children from verified candidate-published parents, centrally monitors pull requests, verifies the final exact-head state, and leaves merge and post-merge closure to the user. Audit observes active SE work and reports problems or workflow improvements without making changes.
defaultPrompt: Use $se:learn to maintain durable repository knowledge, or $se:idea to save a proposal for later planning.
Use $se:feature to turn related requests into clear Feature issues, acceptance criteria, and Macro Tasks without writing code.
Use $se:implement to deliver planned Features through reviewed pull requests, or $se:audit to observe active SE work without changing it.
